content.value_statement: Slow PostgreSQL systems need structured analysis before changes. This skill guides query tuning, index planning, configuration review, maintenance, and monitoring.
actual_capabilities: Guides initial PostgreSQL performance assessment and bottleneck review.
Structures slow query analysis with execution plans and scan types.
Helps plan B-tree, composite, and partial index strategies.
Outlines configuration tuning for memory, cache, checkpoints, and autovacuum.
Defines maintenance checks for vacuum, analyze, table bloat, and statistics.
Organizes monitoring tasks for dashboards, alerts, metrics, and trends.
limitations: Does not connect to databases or run SQL automatically.
Requires users to provide query plans, schema details, and performance metrics.
Cannot guarantee safe production changes without environment-specific review.
Depends on other referenced skills for deeper specialized workflows.

use_cases.title: Triage Slow Production Queries
use_cases.description: Review slow queries, execution plans, scan types, joins, and timing before proposing tuning work.

use_cases.title: Plan Better Index Coverage
use_cases.description: Identify missing or ineffective indexes and compare B-tree, composite, and partial index options.

use_cases.title: Prepare Database Maintenance Work
use_cases.description: Create a checklist for vacuum, analyze, bloat checks, autovacuum review, monitoring, and alerting.

prompt_templates.title: Assess a Slow Database
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner assessment of a PostgreSQL performance problem.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my PostgreSQL database performance and list the first checks I should run.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Slow Query
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused query analysis with available plan details.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to analyze a slow PostgreSQL query, explain likely bottlenecks, and suggest safer tuning steps.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Index Improvements
prompt_templates.scenario: Index design for known tables and workload patterns.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design an indexing strategy for these tables and describe tradeoffs before changes.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Production Optimization Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced phased planning for a production PostgreSQL environment.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a phased PostgreSQL optimization plan covering queries, indexes, configuration, maintenance, monitoring, and validation.

output_examples.input: A backend engineer reports slow account searches during peak traffic.
output: A prioritized assessment checklist for version, settings, slow queries, resource usage, and bottlenecks.
A query review plan covering execution time, scan types, joins, and candidate optimizations.
A validation plan to compare performance before and after each change.

output_examples.input: A data team needs indexes for high-volume reporting tables.
output: A suggested index review workflow for missing, composite, and partial indexes.
A warning list for write overhead, unused indexes, and workload-specific tradeoffs.
A follow-up checklist for usage review and statistics refresh.

output_examples.input: A DBA wants a maintenance and monitoring plan for PostgreSQL.
output: A maintenance schedule covering vacuum, analyze, table bloat, autovacuum, and statistics.
A monitoring outline for dashboards, alerts, core metrics, and trend review.
Quality gates to confirm improved performance and effective operations.

best_practices: Collect query plans, schema details, PostgreSQL version, and metrics before changing settings.
Test each optimization separately and compare measured results before broader rollout.
Review index benefits against write overhead, storage cost, and maintenance impact.
anti_patterns: Changing production configuration without baseline metrics or rollback planning.
Adding many indexes without checking query patterns and write performance.
Treating a single slow query as proof of a database-wide bottleneck.

faq.question: Does this skill run database commands?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow guidance and prompts. Users must run database commands in their approved environment.

faq.question: Can this skill replace a database administrator?
faq.answer: No. It helps structure analysis, but production changes need qualified review and operational approval.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide PostgreSQL version, query plans, schema details, slow query samples, configuration notes, and performance metrics.

faq.question: Does it support managed PostgreSQL services?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow applies to managed PostgreSQL, but provider limits may restrict configuration changes.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Will it automatically fix slow queries?
faq.answer: No. It helps plan and review changes. Users must test and apply fixes themselves.
